assignToKeyId.description: Optional API key identifier to bind this newly-created policy to atomically. When set, the caller must be allowed to manage the key and the create+assign operation consumes a single fresh step-up proof. A template cannot be assigned: setting it with policy.is_template is refused with InvalidArgument. An assistant API key cannot be assigned a policy that allows a money-out action: FailedPrecondition with AUTH_ASSISTANT_KEY_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED. Nor can an admin API key: FailedPrecondition with AUTH_ADMIN_KEY_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED.

actions.description: High-level actions enabled for the API key policy. An empty list grants no access. Up to 64 unique explicit actions are allowed.

description.description: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.

isTemplate.description: Whether the policy is a template, which SetApiKeyPolicy applies as a copy. Only the main account owner creates templates, and never together with assign_to_key_id. Chosen at creation: an update_mask that selects it is refused with InvalidArgument.

name.description: Human-readable policy name. Create requires a non-empty value; update validates it after merging fields selected by update_mask.

spotMarketScope.description: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

spotMarkets.description: Allowed spot markets for this API key policy.

symbol.description: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALL: Allow all current and future markets for this policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ALLOWLIST: Allow only the markets listed on this policy.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLAIM_DAILY_REWARD: Allow claiming the main account's daily reward, paid to the main account or a sub-account it owns. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONVERT_DUST: Allow quoting and converting dust, small Trading balances, into a target asset, and reading the conversions. Listing dust balances needs READ_BALANCES.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREATE_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS: Allow creating a deposit address within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRAFT_STRATEGIES: Allow validating and storing bot strategy versions, running their behaviour examples, and starting backtests. It never deploys, changes, stops or deletes a bot, and grants no read beyond those calls' answers. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW: Allow value to leave Trading through external withdrawals. Destination authorization is enforced separately from this policy. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_TRANSFER: Allow internal transfers between sub-accounts or linked Polyester accounts, including reading internal transfer history. Moves value out of the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow creating, updating, deleting, and copying saved destination entries, including reading the address book. Address-book writes accept only a session token, so on an API-key policy this grants address-book reads only. It manages where value can leave the account, so an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_API_KEYS: Allow creating, updating and revoking the standard API keys of the main account and of the sub-accounts it owns. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key, which never manages an admin or assistant key, a key whose policy allows a money-out action, or a sub-account shared with the main account. A key it creates or updates needs an IP allowlist within the admin key's own.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_API_KEY_POLICIES: Allow attaching and clearing the API policies of the standard API keys the admin key may manage. A policy it attaches can never allow a money-out action or an admin permission, and on a sub-account key can never allow more actions or markets than the sub-account's policy. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow creating, changing, and disabling the auto-withdraw rule, including reading it. A rule pays value out, so changing one also requires EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW, API keys can never change one, and an assistant API key can never be allowed it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_PRICE_ALERTS: Allow creating, updating, and cancelling the main account's price alerts. It does not allow listing them. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MANAGE_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow attaching, clearing and updating the policies of the sub-accounts the main account owns. The resulting policy can never allow a money-out action, and a locked policy is never changed. Admin permission: honored only for an admin API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROPOSE_STRATEGY_DEPLOY: Allow recording a deploy proposal for a bot strategy version, which the user then deploys on the website with MFA and a wallet signature. It never deploys a bot, creates a subaccount or moves funds. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow listing the security and activity events of the main account and its sub-accounts within the key's scope: a key scoped to the main account reads all of them, a key scoped to a sub-account only that sub-account's. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ACCOUNT_DIRECTORY: Allow resolving an account by username, account ID, or smart-account address. Any key of the main account may use it, whatever its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_ADDRESS_BOOK: Allow reading saved, recent, and whitelisted address-book destinations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_KEYS: Allow listing and reading API keys. A key scoped to the main account sees the main account's keys and those of its sub-accounts; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_API_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading API-key policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every API-key policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policies attached to that sub-account's keys. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_AUTO_WITHDRAW: Allow reading the auto-withdraw rule and its runs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_BALANCES: Allow reading balances and equity for a sub-account or API key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_CHECKPOINTS: Allow reading the main account's checkpoints. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DAILY_CLAIMS: Allow reading the main account's daily reward claim status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_DEPOSIT_ADDRESSES: Allow listing the deposit addresses within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_FUNDING_FLOWS: Allow reading the account's deposit, withdrawal, and transfer flows, including the flows no chain transaction started and the transfers it receives from other accounts. It grants no balance or transfer read.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_GUARD_SIGNER_STATUS: Allow reading the Guard Signer status within the key's scope; a key never reads another main account's Guard Signer. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_NOTIFICATIONS: Allow listing, reading, and counting the main account's notifications. It does not allow marking them read or unread. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PNL: Allow reading the account's profit and loss: realized and unrealized PnL, holdings with their entry price, trading statistics and the daily series. It grants no balance or trade read. Like READ_BALANCES, it is part of every sub-account's read floor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PRICE_ALERTS: Allow listing the main account's price alerts. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_PROFILE: Allow reading the main account's profile and username history. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_REWARDS: Allow reading the main account's published reward awards. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SOCIAL_VERIFICATION: Allow reading the main account's social verification status: provider, handle, status, and verification time. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SPOT: Allow reading spot orders and trades, subscriptions, and cancel-all dry-run. Strictly non-mutating: cancellation and cancel-all-after changes require TRADE_SPOT.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_STATEMENTS: Allow exporting account statements: the account's balance movements for a period, with fees and the balance after each entry. It grants no other balance or transfer read.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_STRATEGIES: Allow reading the main account's bot strategies: their versions, backtests, review summaries, deploy proposals, bots and bot logs. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNTS: Allow listing and reading the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow reading the activity of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_INVITES: Allow listing the outgoing invites of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_MEMBERS: Allow listing the members of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSIONS: Allow reading what the key itself may do on a sub-account within its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading sub-account policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every sub-account policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policy attached to that sub-account. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_VIP_STATUS: Allow reading the main account's VIP status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_WITHDRAW_VALIDATION: Allow validating an external withdraw destination within the key's scope without creating, signing, or reserving a withdraw. It does not allow withdrawing. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_STRATEGIES: Allow stopping the main account's bots, keeping or cancelling their orders. Stopping only reduces what a bot does: it never deploys a bot, changes its money rules or moves funds. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SWAP: Allow quoting, creating, and reading Swaps: market conversions of the account's own Trading balance from one asset into another. Each Swap places spot orders on the account's behalf, which also remain subject to the sub-account's spot trading policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADE_SPOT: Allow all spot order mutations: create, modify, replace, cancel, batch operations, live cancel-all, and arming or disabling cancel-all-after. Includes reading spot orders and trades and placing or modifying triggers. Authorized cancellation remains available when trading activity is disabled; this does not grant mutation access to a read-only API key.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNTS: Allow listing and reading the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_ACTIVITY: Allow reading the activity of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_INVITES: Allow listing the outgoing invites of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_MEMBERS: Allow listing the members of the subaccounts within the key's scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_PERMISSIONS: Allow reading what the key itself may do on a sub-account within its scope. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_SUBACCOUNT_POLICIES: Allow listing and reading sub-account policies. A key scoped to the main account sees every sub-account policy of the main account; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only the policy attached to that sub-account. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_VIP_STATUS: Allow reading the main account's VIP status. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.READ_WITHDRAW_VALIDATION: Allow validating an external withdraw destination within the key's scope without creating, signing, or reserving a withdraw. It does not allow withdrawing. Account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_STRATEGIES: Allow stopping the main account's bots, keeping or cancelling their orders. Stopping only reduces what a bot does: it never deploys a bot, changes its money rules or moves funds. Main-account permission.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SWAP: Allow quoting, creating, and reading Swaps: market conversions of the account's own Trading balance from one asset into another. Each Swap places spot orders on the account's behalf, which also remain subject to the sub-account's spot trading policy.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRADE_SPOT: Allow all spot order mutations: create, modify, replace, cancel, batch operations, live cancel-all, and arming or disabling cancel-all-after. Includes reading spot orders and trades and placing or modifying triggers. Authorized cancellation remains available when trading activity is disabled; this does not grant mutation access to a read-only API key.

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

patch.description: Partially update a subaccount policy using If-Match revision control. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Send {"maxOrderNotional":null} to remove the per-order notional cap, matching a ConnectRPC update mask selecting max_order_notional with its policy value omitted. To set a cap, supply a positive decimal string in quote units with six decimal places of precision. Additional trailing zeros are accepted. Zero and negative values remain invalid. After clearing, GET returns maxOrderNotional as "0", meaning no explicit cap.

parameters.description: Strong ETag revision returned by the latest read.
parameters.name: If-Match

schema.description: Public ID, as a base58 string.

maxOrderNotional.description: New maximum notional of any single order on this sub-account, as a positive decimal string in quote asset units (USDT) with six decimal places of precision, for example '2500.5'. Additional trailing zeros are accepted. Null removes the cap; omit to leave unchanged. '0' is refused.
